title: Parliament Buildings, Barbados

terrainReference.basis: Fixed open southern court approach between the two wings, chosen before terrain sampling. Approximate ground datum only; no stair/foundation survey or terrain flattening.

note: Both separate original native Parliament wing outlines retain rounded ends and projecting blocks around an open courtyard. Exact cleared QuallaPDphotos control coral-stone galleries, shuttered oriels and the surviving WESTclocktower. Native map has no heights or separate tower polygon; elevations, west-projection tower placement, hidden roof sections and ground contact are photographic estimates. Detached neighbors and demolished east tower excluded.
